enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Strength +2: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Strength.
Attack Bonus +4: Provides a +4 competence bonus to your attack rolls.
Heroism: Passive: +2 morale bonus to all your attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks.
Captain's Set: While wearing both items from the Captain's Set, you gain: +1 Quality bonus to Strength
The Devil's Handiwork: While wearing any five items from the The Devil's Handiwork, you gain: +2 Quality bonus to all Ability stats
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
